deliverable: reports/electrolytes.md
key_findings: Text vs Fig 4 discrepancy recorded, not resolved: K<3.5 rate 10 mmol/h (text) vs 10-20 (Fig 4); maintenance 20-30 vs 10-20 mmol/L; resolution >= vs >; Fig 4 has no hold-insulin wording
key_findings: Phosphate threshold: 2024 <1.0 mmol/L (~3.1 mg/dL) vs 2009 <1.0 mg/dL; case phosphate units unknown, interpreted conditionally
key_findings: Day0 chemNa122 vs gasNa131 most consistent with indirect-ISE pseudohyponatremia on top of translocational hyponatremia; method unverified; gas-based corrected Na 136.0/138.5, effective osm 284.8, osmolal gap 25.3; not HHS
key_findings: K nadir 3.2 / latest 3.4 red flag; prioritized monitored repletion; no individualized order (no weight/UO/Cr/ECG/MAR)
not_done: No writes to evidence/, fulltext/, parsed/, other reports, workflow, or git
not_done: Scratch copies of OA XML/slideset kept only in job tmp dir (outside project)
evidence: 2024 consensus verified from Diabetologia OA full text (PMC11343900) + Diabetes Care PMC HTML (PMC11272983); Fig 4 visually read from CC-BY slideset
2009 consensus full text (PMC2699725); ADA 2026 S16 (PMC12690180) partial HTML, Fig 16.1 K numbers NOT verified
